name: Fallen Scots pine trunk section
description: Horizontal fallen pine log: tapered cylinder with two-tone bark (grey-brown lower plates, orange-copper upper), exposed wood end grain, longitudinal bark ridge detail, root-end bulge, a branch-knot scar, and a damp green moss strip on the ground-contact face.

parts.name: Main trunk cylinder (tapered full length)
parts.note: butt r=0.25 m, top r=0.22 m; taper dossier#taper. axis='z' → log lies along Z. Floor-anchored: centre-y = r so bottom sits at y=0.

parts.name: Bottom shadow band — old dark bark + ground shadow
parts.note: Embedded in lower cylinder (y 0–0.12); bevelBox faces are NOT coplanar with the curved cylinder surface — no z-fight

parts.name: Top highlight strip — thin sunlit upper bark layer
parts.note: Centred at y=0.48 → top face at y=0.51, proud 10 mm above cylinder apex at y=0.50; woodMid reads as pale weathered/sunlit bark. No coplanar cylinder face here (cylinder end-caps face ±Z, not ±Y).

parts.name: Left longitudinal bark ridge plate
parts.note: Sits at the left flank of the cylinder; its outer x face at x=-0.25 is flush with the cylinder edge — curved vs flat, no coplanar z-fight

parts.name: Bare wood end face — cut/broken end of the log
parts.note: Disc spans z -1.22 to -1.20. Back face (z=-1.20) is opposite-normal to the main body end cap at same z — safe (opposite-normal contact). Front face (z=-1.22) is 20 mm proud and visible: pale woodMid circle inside barkPine ring.

parts.name: Butt/root-end flare at the wider end of the log
parts.note: Low dark sill at z=[1.00,1.20] reading as root-collar and soil flare. Width 0.48 < cylinder diameter 0.50 — stays within footprint.

parts.name: Old branch-knot scar on the right flank
parts.note: Embedded ~70 mm into the cylinder surface at the right flank; reads as a proud dark recess knot or bark scar

parts.name: Pleurozium ground-contact moss strip (underside of log)
parts.note: Damp зеленомошник-type moss grows on the ground-contact face of fallen logs in pine bor (dossier#moss_feature). Thin strip at y=[0,0.04], embedded in lowest cylinder zone.

needs: Pine trunk taper rate (cm/m) from a forestry reference — current r=0.25→0.22 over 2.4 m is a design estimate (dossier#taper)
Precise Scots pine lower-bark thickness — 'up to ~5 cm' upper bound used; mean not sourced (dossier#bark_texture)
Sourced log-section prop length — current 2.4 m is a game-design value (dossier#log_length)
